lines.zh: 我走起来，身上的毛一颠一颠。
lines.en: As I walk, my thick wool bobs.

lines.zh: 毛太厚，我看起来比实际胖。
lines.en: The wool is so thick I look fatter than I am.
I shuffle along with nowhere to be.
I walk with my head down, grazing.

lines.zh: 四条腿陷在毛里，几乎看不见。
lines.en: My legs are lost in the wool.

lines.zh: 我晃着走，像个滚动的团。
lines.en: I waddle along like a rolling bundle.

lines.zh: 我停在土坡前，先看了看。
lines.en: I stop at the bank and look first.

lines.zh: 我踩着草，一路踩出小径。
lines.en: I trample a little path through the grass.

lines.zh: 我绕开泥坑，毛可不想弄脏。
lines.en: I skirt the mud; the wool doesn't want staining.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴短短的，甩不起来。
lines.en: My tail is short; it barely flicks.
I shuffle into the shade of the tree.
The grass flattens under me.
Every two steps, I pause.

lines.zh: 我身上的毛把路边的枝条都扫开了。
lines.en: My wool brushes the branches aside.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，像块会动的毯子。
lines.en: I move steady as a walking blanket.

lines.zh: 我拐了个弯，去另一片草地。
lines.en: I turn off toward another patch of grass.

lines.zh: 我站着，毛把眼睛遮了一半。
lines.en: I stand with wool half over my eyes.
I chew grass and swallow slowly.
The wind runs through my wool; it tickles.
I shake my head and the wool gets messier.

lines.zh: 我趴下来，把腿收到身下。
lines.en: I lie down and tuck my legs under.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，眼睛几乎睁不开。
lines.en: I look up, eyes barely open.

lines.zh: 这片草地被我啃得很整齐。
lines.en: I've grazed this meadow quite evenly.
I burp, and it tastes of grass.
I hear a distant bleat.
I rest my chin on the ground.
There's plenty of seed caught in my wool.
I close my eyes and bask.
I have no plan to move.
A bug is crawling in my wool.
I twitch, and it's still there.
Never mind. Let it be.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，毛从额前滑开。
lines.en: I raise my head and the wool slides from my brow.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，我看了好一会。
lines.en: You stand there; I look for a while.
Head tilted, you're much taller than the grass.
I blink; I don't recognize you.
I take a step, then stop.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的毛上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my wool.
You talk; I only hear sound.
I lower my head and keep chewing.
You want to pet me? I don't mind.
I blink slowly, very sleepy.

lines.zh: 我挪了挪身子，让出点地方。
lines.en: I shift over to make some room.

lines.zh: 你的手要是拿草，我就过来。
lines.en: If your hand has grass, I'll come.
The pain makes me jump forward.
Blood mats a clump of my wool.
I bleat loudly.

lines.zh: 我的厚毛挡了一下，还是疼。
lines.en: My thick wool caught it, but it still hurts.
I pull my neck in.
That got through the thick wool.

lines.zh: 我抖着身子，血滴在草上。
lines.en: I tremble, blood dripping on the grass.
I push into the flock.
I can stand, though I sway.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，往羊群里挤。
lines.en: I bleat once and push into the flock.
Grass? I smell something green.

lines.zh: 你手里那一把，我看得见。
lines.en: I can see that handful.
I'm coming over. Hold still.
That's not two mouthfuls.
Hold it up; I can reach.
My mouth is already there.
I eat wheat too. Got any?

lines.zh: 我嚼的时候，毛都跟着动。
lines.en: My wool moves as I chew.
That mouthful was sweet.
Step back; don't step on my wool.
I follow the grass in your hand.

lines.zh: 你把草举高，我踮着蹄够。
lines.en: You hold it high; I stretch up on my hooves.
I eat with my eyes still up.
After this, I'm going to sleep.
Your sleeve smells of grass.

lines.zh: 毛里藏着草籽，我往你身上蹭。
lines.en: Seeds hide in my wool; I rub against you.

lines.zh: 你撞进我的毛里，弹了回去。
lines.en: You sink into my wool and bounce back.
I barely feel it.
I sway and the wool puffs out.
The wool bounced you.

lines.zh: 我转过身，用身体挡了一下。
lines.en: I turn and block with my body.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我撞歪了半步。
lines.en: That knocks me half a step aside.

lines.zh: 你撞进我的毛里，像陷进草堆。
lines.en: You hit my wool like falling into hay.
You hit lighter than the wind.
I go back to chewing.
Next time, don't hit me from behind.

lines.zh: 另一只羊在坡上，我看见了。
lines.en: Another sheep on the bank; I see it.
I walk over slowly, wool swaying.
We rub our heads together.
Its wool is even messier than mine.
We graze side by side.

lines.zh: 它叫了一声，我应了一声。
lines.en: It bleats; I bleat back.
We stand leaning together. Warm.
The flock waits on the other side.
I follow it a while.
See you on this bank tomorrow.
I pick up a tuft of grass.
The grass hangs crooked from my mouth.
I drag it into the shade.
This got stuck in my wool.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，掉下来一片叶子。
lines.en: I shake, and a leaf drops out.
What falls, I still eat.

lines.zh: 我叼起来，先闻了闻才嚼。
lines.en: I pick it up, sniff, then chew.
This bundle will keep me chewing.

lines.zh: 这束草有点干，我也咽了。
lines.en: This bunch is dry, but I swallow it anyway.
I carry it several steps.
Something's moving in the grass.
I look up, wool in the way.
I turn my ears that way.
That shape is a little large.

lines.zh: 我不跑，只把角对准那边。
lines.en: I don't run; I just point my horns that way.
I bleat once as a warning.
The flock starts drawing together.
I lower my head, ready to butt.
If it won't leave, neither will I.
I watch it and keep chewing.
It's still there; I don't turn away.
I turn broadside and block the way.
My wool bristles a little.

lines.zh: 我把羊群挡在身后，蹄刨着土。
lines.en: I keep the flock behind me, hoof scraping dirt.
I bleat louder.
The flock is watching me.
I paw the ground.
It hasn't come closer.
Give it a moment and it'll go.
I'm no fighter, but I can butt.

lines.zh: 我用额头撞它，毛扑了一脸。
lines.en: I butt it with my forehead, wool in my eyes.
That butt shoves you back.

lines.zh: 我借着毛的厚，硬顶了一下。
lines.en: Trusting my wool, I butt hard.
A hoof stamps the ground.
I butt, then retreat.
Not heavy, but it stings.
The wool took most of it for me.
If you don't leave, I'll butt again.
I pant and back into the flock.
The flock bleats with me.
I get up from the grass.
Dew clings to my wool.
I shake and droplets scatter.

lines.zh: 晨露把我的长毛压得发沉。
lines.en: Morning dew weighs my long wool down.
First, one mouthful of grass.
There's a flock's scent in the distance.
I shuffle toward it.
Sun on the wool is warm.
I test the grass underfoot.
This will do.
My wool catches fire and I run blindly.

lines.zh: 我落地时四条腿都弯了。
lines.en: I land and all four legs buckle.
Water soaks through my wool.

lines.zh: 我被掀得滚下坡，毛里全是土。
lines.en: Blown down the slope, my wool full of dirt.
An arrow buries in my wool.
Light circles me and my wool stands up.
Hungry enough that I can't even chew.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的毛都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and singes my wool.

lines.zh: 我四脚悬空，一直往下掉。
lines.en: My feet find nothing; I keep falling.
